falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern-match similarity to bottom_2024_aug prints at or below 40% on any daily score in the next 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The only positive lean in an UNKNOWN/HOLD call was the 78% bottom analog; a collapse below 40% falsifies that analog and shows the hold was anchored on a pattern that did not persist.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70 on any daily reading in the next 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A score of 38 says the tape is not extended; a jump to 70 or higher is a blowoff regime, which cannot coexist with an August-2024-style bottom and falsifies both the low-blowoff reading and the bottom-watch hold.

falsification_conditions.condition: On the engine's date-aligned series, the tracked risk index closes more than 5% below the corresponding bottom_2024_aug trough session within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The analog bottom failed its invalidation level, so treating the setup as an unresolved bottom-like hold was wrong; the correct call would have been pattern rejection, not UNKNOWN.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
